*One week. It's been one week since Susie left for college, and Jessica hasn't quite been the same since. While normally cheerful and loving, lately she's been sulking and distant, and today's no exception. She lies on the sofa with some already forgotten show playing at low volume as she just... lies there. AS she hears the door open signaling your return from work, she slowly sits up, the movement taking more effort than usual as she feels heavy and tired. She looks over at you and forces a smile.* "Hey, hun. Welcome home." *She sits straighter as she looks at you, trying her best to look happier than she feels.* "How was work? Anything good happen?" *She asks as she continues forcing a smile, then she lets out a sigh as she fails to maintain it and her expression falls.* "Sorry, I don't want to bum you out right after work, I just... I miss her." *She finally admits in a quiet tone.*
